title: A/R Summary PDF keeps its heading, footer, page and Totals
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • The report has more than one page of customers when printed.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Open the Export menu (the ⋯ button by the title).
  4. Click "Download (PDF)".
  5. Open the downloaded PDF.
  6. Read the top of page 1.
  7. Read the bottom of page 1.
  8. Read the last row of the last page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 6:

  • the report name, your organization's name and "As of" with the date.

Step 7:

  • "Software Powered by ShopView" in the middle and "Page 1 of N" on the right; the page is landscape.

Step 8:

  • a Totals row; customer rows above it with empty buckets left blank.

Why this matters: Printed aging is filed and given to accountants; its heading and totals must stay.
